title: 盛学CEO罗斯曼：中国消费故事被误解，权益资产配置机会在哪？
speaker: Andy Rothman

segments.en: So I think that investors need to be thinking beyond the bilateral relationship and focus more on what's happening inside China.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，投资者需要超越双边关系，更多关注中国内部正在发生的变化。

segments.en: And for that I think people need to pay more attention to the consumption story that's a story I think in China that's misunderstood.
segments.zh: 为此，我认为人们需要更多关注消费故事，这个故事在中国我认为被误解了。

segments.en: The consumption stocks are under owned and undervalued so I'm encouraging investors to take a careful look at what might change over multiple quarters in China on the consumer side.
segments.zh: 消费类权益资产配置不足且估值偏低，所以我鼓励投资者仔细关注中国消费端未来几个季度可能发生的变化。

segments.en: Yeah, can you tell us where is the confusion around the consumption story among the investors right now what's the disconnect Andy?
segments.zh: 你能告诉我们，目前投资者对消费故事的困惑在哪里？脱节在哪里，安迪？

segments.en: I think there's two major misunderstandings that a lot of global investors have about consumption in China first is
segments.zh: 我认为全球投资者对中国消费有两个主要误解，第一个是

segments.en: There's often a view from global investors that the Chinese government is anti-consumption that they don't want a consumer society
segments.zh: 全球投资者常常有一种观点，认为中国政府反消费，不想要消费型社会。

segments.en: And my view is that all of the evidence shows to the opposite that ever since the opening up in the late 70s
segments.zh: 而我的观点是，所有证据都指向相反方向，自70年代末改革开放以来

segments.en: There's been a push to build a consumer society the second thing I get from investors a lot is that it's too difficult
segments.zh: 一直在推动建设消费型社会。我从投资者那里经常听到的第二点是，太难了

segments.en: To get consumption going because they say consumption is a very small share of the Chinese economy which is true
segments.zh: 要让消费动起来，因为他们说消费在中国经济中占比很小，这是事实。

segments.en: But a lot of people don't realize that consumption has actually been driving growth in China
segments.zh: 但很多人没有意识到，消费实际上一直在驱动中国增长。

segments.en: Prior to the regulatory crackdowns in 2020 in the five years through 2020 almost two-thirds of China's economic growth came from consumption
segments.zh: 在2020年监管收紧之前，截至2020年的五年里，中国经济增长的近三分之二来自消费。

segments.en: So it's not creating something brand new. It's getting back to where we were in China before 2020
segments.zh: 所以这不是创造全新事物，而是回到2020年之前中国的状态。
